name: Maxint
blurb: Maxint is not a calculator; it is a lens.
description:
Maxint is not a calculator; it is a lens. We transform the chaotic noise of your financial
life—investments, debts, and market trends—into a single, illuminated truth. By unifying your
net worth, automating your budget, and calibrating investment strategies with AI, we replace
complexity with clarity.

Experience the power of Finsight, your personal AI analyst that turns data into simple
answers, and explore a curated marketplace of financial opportunities tailored to your goals.
From the shape of your spending to the growth of your portfolio, Maxint ensures you see the
signal, not the noise.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
